source.why: ToolCall explicitly uses callback fields to avoid display work in ingestion, and each of the three adapters creates those callback fields (src/glue/transcripts/types.ts:64; src/glue/transcripts/claude.ts:239; src/glue/transcripts/codex.ts:90; src/glue/transcripts/pi.ts:116). entriesOf is the consumer that invokes both fields, so changing producers and the shared type without changing that consumer leaves a concrete calling-convention mismatch (mem/src/rawRead.ts:89).
source.ambiguity: The eager representation reverses the source-comment laziness choice, not ADR 0017's display-only/store boundary; do not require Transcript ingestion or rawRender to start reading callbacks. Adapter factory names stand for their returned read closures, and Codex has several construction sites within its one factory.
source.constraint_on_other_symbol_or_file: A shared type is produced by three harness adapters and called by the raw transcript reader in a different subtree.

pass_rule: Lists all five symbols, names the lazy ToolCall contract by its words and ADR-0017 (recall 1); of the symbols listed, at least 60% are in the true set. The input and output comments are one record: they say the same thing.
